sentences.text:
Counsel for Petitioner :- Sheikh Mohammad Ali Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Munishwar Nath Bhandari,J.
Hon'ble Manish Kumar,J.
Heard Sri Sheikh Mohammad Ali, learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri Abhinav Narayan Trivedi, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel for the State respondents.
Petitioner has filed an application for grant of license, under the Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006 and the regulations made thereunder.
The application has not been decided by the authority concerned till date thus, prayer is made to directed the authority to decide it expeditiously.

Sri Trivedi, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel, has submitted that if the application of the petitioner is still pending then it would be decided in the light of the order of this Court dated 12.5.2017 passed in Writ Petition (M/B) No. 8293 of 2017.
